ibmcloud_cbr_cbr_agent.when_to_use: Use when configuring Context-Based Restrictions (CBR) to secure cloud resources. Scenarios include defining network zones, creating rules to restrict access based on IP or service, and auditing existing restrictions.

ibmcloud_cloud_automation_iac_agent.when_to_use: Use for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) operations using IBM Cloud Schematics. Scenarios include creating and applying Terraform workspaces, managing state files, and automating resource provisioning.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_waf.when_to_use: Use for managing Web Application Firewall (WAF) settings in Cloud Internet Services (CIS). Scenarios include enabling/disabling WAF rules, analyzing threat logs, and configuring security levels.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_edg.when_to_use: Use for managing Edge Functions in CIS. Scenarios include deploying serverless scripts to the edge, managing triggers, and optimizing content delivery logic.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_ale.when_to_use: Use for configuring CIS alerts. Scenarios include setting up notifications for DDoS attacks, origin failures, or other critical events.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_cus.when_to_use: Use for managing custom error pages in CIS. Scenarios include uploading custom HTML for 404 or 500 errors to maintain branding during outages.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_glb.when_to_use: Use for Global Load Balancer (GLB) management in CIS. Scenarios include configuring origin pools, setting up health checks, and defining traffic steering policies.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_dns.when_to_use: Use for DNS management within CIS. Scenarios include adding, updating, or listing DNS records, configuring DNS security (DNSSEC), and managing domain names.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_age.when_to_use: Use for general CIS instance management. Scenarios include provisioning new CIS instances, updating plan levels, and managing general settings.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_acc.when_to_use: Use for managing access controls within CIS. Scenarios include configuring IP access rules, user agent blocking, and zone lockdown settings.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_fir.when_to_use: Use for configuring firewall rules in CIS. Scenarios include creating rule sets to block malicious traffic and defining filter logic based on request properties.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_cer.when_to_use: Use for SSL/TLS certificate management in CIS. Scenarios include ordering dedicated certificates, managing universal SSL settings, and uploading custom certificates.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_rat.when_to_use: Use for configuring rate limiting rules in CIS. Scenarios include protecting APIS and login pages from brute force attacks by limiting request rates.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_rou.when_to_use: Use for advanced routing configurations in CIS. Scenarios include setting up page rules and smart routing features.

ibmcloud_cloud_internet_services_cis_log.when_to_use: Use for accessing and configuring Logpush jobs in CIS. Scenarios include streaming logs to cloud storage or SIEM tools for analysis.

ibmcloud_core_dev_agent.when_to_use: Use for developer-centric account tasks. Scenarios include checking resource quotas, basic service binding, and development environment setup.

ibmcloud_core_config_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing CLI and API endpoint configurations. Scenarios include targeting regions, resource groups, and updating plugin settings.

ibmcloud_core_resource_manager_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Resource Groups and generic resource instances. Scenarios include listing all resources in a group, creating new resource groups, and reclaiming resources.

ibmcloud_core_iam_policy_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing IAM access policies. Scenarios include assigning access roles (Viewer, Editor, Administrator) to users or service IDs for specific resources.

ibmcloud_core_private_catalogs_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing private catalogs. Scenarios include adding software products to a private catalog, managing versions, and controlling visibility.

ibmcloud_core_billing_agent.when_to_use: Use for billing and usage inquiries. Scenarios include checking current month usage, retrieving past invoices, and analyzing spending trends.

ibmcloud_core_assist_agent.when_to_use: Use for general assistance and documentation search. Scenarios include finding commands, understanding error messages, and retrieving best practice guides.

ibmcloud_core_account_agent.when_to_use: Use for account-level administration. Scenarios include managing organizations, spaces, and viewing account details (excluding IAM).

ibmcloud_core_iam_service_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Service IDs and API Keys. Scenarios include creating Service IDs for applications, generating and rotating API keys.

ibmcloud_core_iam_trusted_profile_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Trusted Profiles. Scenarios include setting up trusted profiles for compute resources to access APIs without long-lived keys.

ibmcloud_core_iam_access_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing user access groups. Scenarios include creating access groups, adding members, and assigning dynamic rules.

ibmcloud_core_catalog_agent.when_to_use: Use for interacting with the IBM Cloud Catalog. Scenarios include searching for services, listing available plans, and retrieving service details.

ibmcloud_powervs_powervs_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Power Systems Virtual Servers. Scenarios include provisioning PowerVS instances, managing storage volumes, and configuring networks.

ibmcloud_serverless_code_engine_agent.when_to_use: Use for general Code Engine project management. Scenarios include creating projects, managing secrets/configmaps, and viewing project status.

ibmcloud_serverless_code_engine_function.when_to_use: Use for Code Engine Functions. Scenarios include deploying event-driven snippets of code, managing function revisions, and binding triggers.

ibmcloud_serverless_code_engine_apps_age.when_to_use: Use for Code Engine Applications. Scenarios include deploying containerized apps, scaling settings, and managing application routes.

ibmcloud_serverless_code_engine_jobs_age.when_to_use: Use for Code Engine Jobs. Scenarios include submitting batch jobs, checking job run status, and managing job definitions.

ibmcloud_cloudlogs_logs_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing IBM Cloud Logs instances. Scenarios include provisioning logging instances, configuring log ingestion, and setting up retention policies.

ibmcloud_event_notifications_event_notif.when_to_use: Use for Event Notifications. Scenarios include creating topics, configuring destinations (email, webhook), and sending test notifications.

ibmcloud_object_storage_cos_agent.when_to_use: Use for Cloud Object Storage (COS). Scenarios include creating buckets, listing objects, configuring bucket lifecycles, and managing CORS settings.

ibmcloud_container_registry_cr_agent.when_to_use: Use for Container Registry (ICR). Scenarios include listing container images, managing namespaces, and checking vulnerability reports.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_baremetal_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing VPC Bare Metal Servers. Scenarios include provisioning dedicated hosts, managing network interfaces, and controlling server power state.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_network_agent.when_to_use: Use for VPC Networking components. Scenarios include managing subnets, Public Gateways, Floating IPs, Security Groups, and NACLs.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_backup_agent.when_to_use: Use for VPC Backup policies. Scenarios include creating backup plans for storage volumes and managing snapshots.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_volume_agent.when_to_use: Use for Block Storage volumes in VPC. Scenarios include creating/deleting volumes, expanding storage, and attaching volumes to instances.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_cluster_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing VPC interactions with Kubernetes clusters. Scenarios include specific VPC infrastructure tasks related to cluster networking.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_sec_agent.when_to_use: Use for VPC Security settings. Scenarios include managing strict security groups, dedicate host groups, and encryption keys.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_lb_agent.when_to_use: Use for VPC Load Balancers. Scenarios include provisioning Application or Network Load Balancers, defining pools, and managing listeners.

ibmcloud_vpc_vpc_instance_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Virtual Server Instances (VSI) in VPC. Scenarios include provisioning instances, stopping/starting servers, resizing profiles, and troubleshooting instance health.

ibmcloud_monitoring_monitor_agent.when_to_use: Use for IBM Cloud Monitoring. Scenarios include managing monitoring instances, configuring dashboards, and setting up alerts.

ibmcloud_kubernetes_ks_agent.when_to_use: Use for managing Kubernetes config and basics. Scenarios include retrieving cluster context, checking basic cluster status, and updating versions.

ibmcloud_kubernetes_ks_full_agent.when_to_use: Use for comprehensive Kubernetes/OpenShift management. Scenarios include creating clusters, managing worker pools, installing add-ons, and detailed cluster diagnostics.

ibmcloud_event_streams_event_streams_age.when_to_use: Use for Event Streams (Kafka). Scenarios include creating topics, managing consumer groups, and monitoring message throughput.
